messages:
erin: follow-up on the dedicated-shard pool idea i posted. want to lock operator APIs and stabilization rules before the RFC freeze

devon: main worry: keeping fast-path p99 low without starving steady tenants

erin: proposal: dual-lane inside each pool: fast-path (prewarmed, light packing) + steady-path (dense packing, accepts cold starts)

kai: promotions/demotions are a thrash risk. what's the dampening?
erin: require sustained demand: config sustain_window_s. trigger when fast_path_util > 0.8 for sustain_window_s. move a bounded chunk and set cooldowns
tessa: how big is the chunk? we need defaults and tenant overrides
erin: default chunk = min(10% of pool, 2 gpus). tenants with SLA can set an override capped by contract
devon: billing: if we reassign GPUs to fast-path, who gets billed? need clear ledger semantics
erin: two-layer accounting: baseline reservation billed normally. transient fast-path use recorded to burst_ledger with {tenant, gpus, start, end, preemptible}

kai: eviction priority must be explicit. draft order: pinned_reservations -> gold SLA -> silver SLA -> burst_credit_holders -> preemptible
tessa: fairness over time? small frequent bursters could monopolize the burst pool
erin: add burst_score per tenant with exponential decay (half-life ~1h). admission favors tenants with lower recent share
devon: controller topology question: operator-per-shard vs single global reconciler?
erin: hybrid: operator-per-shard does local decisions. global reconciler (leader elected) enforces pool-wide caps and coordinates cross-shard moves
kai: KV cache warming risk when promoting active instances. could spike latency
erin: operator will prefer allocating idle (cold) instances into fast-path first. live demote only for low-util instances or when KV can be synced; otherwise drain steady nodes gradually
orch-bot: deploy-planner: creating canary template and preflight probes for us-west-2 now
tessa: rollout plan + metrics? prefer feature flag per-region
erin: canary us-west-2, 10% of pools, 48h. metrics: fast_path_util, p99_latency_by_SLA, promotion_count, eviction_events, burst_ledger_debits
devon: ledger retention for billing disputes?
erin: default 180d; after 30d compress to daily aggregates to save storage
kai: test plan: unit tests for admission math, k8s-integration for operator behavior, chaos tests for leader failover and promotion under churn
erin: will draft follow-up RFC tonight with config schema, rollout checklist, and dashboard mockups
tessa: nit: rename promotion_window_s -> sustain_window_s to clarify intent
erin: updated in draft. syncing tomorrow 10am PT to finalize thresholds
erin: thanks all :thumbsup:
